example.title: Zinda Saloon, 844 Main Street
example.source: HABS WI-295 (photos/drawings via Wikimedia Commons mirror of HABS)

brief: Two-storey red-brick commercial building marking the edge of the old public square: a corbelled arcade of brick arches under a plain parapet, five 1/1 upper windows, and two storefronts - a tavern front with a brand sign, a small window and door, and a plain plate-glass store front beside it - with a Coke machine on the sidewalk.

storefronts.sign: HASKINS PIZZA - DINE IN - CARRY OUT
